; DEVELOPMENT ONLY.
;
; Plaintext passwords here let PgBouncer perform SCRAM authentication
; onward to PostgreSQL. That is fine on a laptop and unacceptable in
; production, where this file is generated from secrets at deploy time
; and never committed.
;
; Production checklist:
;   · generate from the secret store, mode 0600, owned by the pgbouncer user
;   · rotate alongside the database passwords
;   · never bake into an image layer

"app_user" "app_user_dev_pw"
"app_migrator" "app_migrator_dev_pw"
